prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original environment prop master spritesheet for a tiny side-scrolling pixel garden action roguelite.
Create ONE transparent spritesheet containing exactly FIFTEEN isolated world objects arranged in a perfectly aligned FOUR COLUMN by FOUR ROW grid, with the last cell empty. No background or ground. No captions, no words, no letters, no UI badges, no icons in circles. These are physical in-world little machines and architectural relics.
Art direction: bold Nordic garden ruins, dark ink outlines used sparingly, wide chunky simple silhouettes, teal oxidized metal, ancient ceramic, muted moss, ochre brass, occasional amber glass. Lit state uses strong pale CYAN inner light. 16-colour feel, pixel-art hard square edges, flat purposeful colour clusters, two-tone shading only, never realistic textured noise. Side-on orthographic videogame view; consistent light from upper-left. Props will be just 24 to 28 pixels tall at native game size and must read instantly at that size. Full object shown in each cell, separated by generous transparent margins, never touch or cross a neighbouring cell. Put the foot of each object on a consistent invisible baseline.
The first THREE ROWS contain six pairs of designs: each pair must be the EXACT SAME physical object in idle and activated state. Each small prop comfortably fits a square cell, same dimensions in both states. Arrange as follows:
ROW 1:
cell1 RELAY BEACON idle: a short forked teal stone pedestal holding a single large dark faceted droplet lamp, two tiny copper side terminals, solid foot.
cell2 the IDENTICAL RELAY BEACON activated: same silhouette, big luminous cyan drop and bright gold terminals, no bloom beyond pixels.
cell3 THREE-BELL CARILLON idle: compact freestanding asymmetrical bronze frame with precisely three small hanging bells of different lengths, visible ropes, a weighty teal base.
cell4 IDENTICAL THREE-BELL CARILLON activated: each bell interior bright cyan, bronze edge warmed amber, same framing and scale.
ROW 2:
cell1 SEALED SALVAGE POD idle: a low squat octagonal salvage vessel in dark teal metal, prominent pale amber diagonal seal across its single front latch, four short feet, no lettering.
cell2 IDENTICAL SALVAGE POD opened: angular top hinges open in place exposing a bright cyan seed core, cracked amber seal falls against the rim, keep same base.
cell3 WATCH TELESCOPE idle: a short heavy brass angled telescope pointing up-right on a crooked teal tripod, oversized single black lens and a small counterweight.
cell4 IDENTICAL TELESCOPE activated: large lens glows cyan, brass rim bright, same pose, same base.
ROW 3:
cell1 REWARD ALTAR idle: small low monolithic stone altar, carved bowl on top with three tall stylized seed teeth around it, empty dark central socket.
cell2 IDENTICAL ALTAR activated: a large luminous cyan seed floats immediately inside the bowl, amber ring in the stone, same shape otherwise.
cell3 CACHE NOOK SIGNPOST idle: a gnarled low forked wooden post with an actual broad carved leaf-shaped plaque pointing right; plaque bears just one simple carved notch, NO lettering. Teal weathered wood and dull bronze rivet.
cell4 IDENTICAL CACHE SIGNPOST discovered: its single carved notch and leaf edge glow warm gold, same physical silhouette.
ROW 4 has THREE much larger TALL architecture sprites: each still contained within its cell and isolated, about twice the visual height of small props. These will become 48 pixels wide × 64 high, so make their silhouettes vertically elongated and readable. Last cell left TRANSPARENT/EMPTY.
cell1 BROKEN GEAR PUMP: eccentric old tall water pump machine, huge half-broken brass cog on left, dark teal barrel on right, a snaking pipe curling over top, low broad masonry foundation, a few moss patches.
cell2 RIBBED RUIN ARCH: very tall narrow open gateway made of five heavy crooked teal stone ribs and pale ceramic edge blocks, broken asymmetrical crown, completely open central void, base feet on both sides. NO fill behind arch.
cell3 SUSPENDED GREAT BELL: a tall narrow freestanding weathered two-post iron gallows with large old brass bell hanging on thick rope high inside it, crooked weight at side, slender base with two broad planted feet; central negative space is clear.
cell4 EMPTY TRANSPARENT.
All objects are from the SAME distinctive visual family. Strong silhouette and functional construction matter more than decoration. No gradients or soft glows, no ground shadows, no background. The actual canvas must have alpha transparency.
